new_claims.statement: For an exact-rank-three Schur-isotropic target form with three nonzero eigenvalues of modulus at least one, without source separation, orient the sign so the inertia is (2+,1-). Then the essential density is at most pi*sqrt(2) on the one-sheet half-line.

new_claims.statement: In the account03/B18 isotropic-shear coordinates with r>=1, if every physical pair determinant has magnitude <tau, then for q_j=<v_j,e2> one has max_j q_j^2<2tau and sum_j A_0j^2=(r*kappa)^2>=1/2; hence more than 1/(2tau) nonzero star leaves.

Using the first three normalized Walsh-Hadamard columns and D_r=[[0,1/s,0],[1/s,0,0],[0,0,1]], u=r e1, gives exact nonzero spectrum {-1,1,1}; every residual row violates partner source separation; diagonals are <=3/m, hub pair determinants <=1/m, residual pair determinants <=18/m^2, so the family lies in N3 for sufficiently large m.
